query: AMD Data Center segment revenue Q3 2026 Instinct EPYC
normalized: 2026 amd center data epyc instinct q3 revenue segment

output.content:
AMD has **not yet reported Q3 2026 results** as of October 17, 2026, so no actual Q3 Data Center segment-revenue figure—or disclosed Q3 split between Instinct GPUs and EPYC CPUs—is available. 

For Q3 2026, AMD’s guidance is for **total company revenue of approximately $13.0 billion, plus or minus $0.3 billion**; it did not provide Data Center segment guidance in that release. [[1]] 

The latest reported segment result is **Q2 2026 Data Center revenue of $6.7 billion**, up **107% year over year**, driven by strong demand for **AMD EPYC processors** and **AMD Instinct GPUs**. [[1]] 

Management said it expected Data Center sales to **accelerate in the second half of 2026**, citing accelerating EPYC demand, scaling Instinct deployments, and the beginning of the Helios ramp. [[1]]

sources.title: AMD Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results :: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD)
